execution_requirements.replay_command: acquire NOAA CO-OPS water_level and predictions endpoints listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/earth_space/coverage_work_orders/oc133_earth_space_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: observed hidden water-level values appear in visible inputs; NOAA source snapshot hashes are missing or change on replay; comparator residual ties or beats the model within the uncertainty policy; fewer than 20 hidden timestamps are scored

incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Predict each hidden observed water-level row using only the paired official NOAA tide prediction value at the same timestamp.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

replay.replay_command: acquire NOAA CO-OPS water_level and predictions endpoints listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/earth_space/coverage_work_orders/oc133_earth_space_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check
replay_commands: acquire NOAA CO-OPS water_level and predictions endpoints listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/earth_space/coverage_work_orders/oc133_earth_space_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

residual_requirement.formula: absolute residual per hidden six-minute timestamp; aggregate MAE and RMSE
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model MAE plus uncertainty allowance must be lower than comparator MAE and every timestamp hash must remain bound

residuals.material_margin_rule: model MAE plus uncertainty allowance must be lower than comparator MAE and every timestamp hash must remain bound

source.source_authority: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
source.source_name: NOAA CO-OPS Data Retrieval API water level and tide prediction observations

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute residual per hidden six-minute timestamp; aggregate MAE and RMSE
uncertainty_requirement.rule: pre-target median absolute deviation of visible residuals plus NOAA reported standard deviation field where present

why_it_failed: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.
